description: Foundation: package.json + dependencies, env/config/db pool, app.js (helmet CSP, cookie-parser, JSON-only mutating requests, static src/public, root redirect to landingpage/index.html), error handling, JWT cookie auth (login/logout/me/forgot-password), GET /meta and GET /reference, additive schema changes in db.sql (plan D11), the shared front-end boot loader (api.js), rewritten store.js/portal.js/core.js without storage, every HTML script block switched to the boot loader, student + staff sign-in pages wired to the API, and the verification harness under .be-tmp/verify. Independent of FEAT-002..005 but all of them depend on it.
steps: Read c:/Users/CedrikHwang/FSDP-C19/.be-tmp/plan.md sections 1, 2, 4 and 7 fully, then database/db.sql and the users/staff/student/membership parts of database/seed.sql.

Create package.json (name ask-dojo-backend, private, scripts: start 'node app.js', dev 'node --watch app.js', test 'node scripts/placeholder-test.js'), scripts/placeholder-test.js (prints that the project has no unit tests yet and exits 0; must tolerate extra args such as --runInBand), run `npm install express pg bcryptjs jsonwebtoken cookie-parser dotenv helmet express-rate-limit zod` in the repo root so package-lock.json is produced. Check `git check-ignore package.json package-lock.json` and note the result for the report. Do NOT edit .gitignore.
Edit .env.example: append JWT_SECRET=change_me_to_a_long_random_string and JWT_EXPIRES_IN=8h placeholders only. Never touch .env.

Create src/config/index.js (dotenv, PORT, NODE_ENV, DB_*, DB_POOL_MAX, DB_SSL, JWT_SECRET fail-fast in production and warned dev fallback otherwise, JWT_EXPIRES_IN, APP_TZ default Asia/Singapore, APP_FAKE_TODAY accepted only when NODE_ENV !== 'production' and validated as YYYY-MM-DD, API_PREFIX '/api/v1') and src/config/db.js (pg Pool, type parsers per plan D9, query(), withTx(); never log secrets).

Create src/utils/{clock,errors,password,csv}.js, src/middleware/{auth,roles,validate,requireJson,error,rateLimit,security}.js per plan D5-D8 and D25. auth.js reads cookie ask_token, verifies the JWT, re-loads user + profile (student/instructor/staff, membership status) via models and rejects inactive staff. roles.js exports requireRole(...roles) and requireAdminType('business').

Create models userModel.js and referenceModel.js (dojo without qr_token, belt_rank, package_def, policy_setting public subset, class_template public rows with instructor names, instructor_profile list), controllers + routes (src/routes/index.js mounting under /api/v1, meta.routes.js, auth.routes.js) and validators/auth.js. Implement GET /meta, GET /reference (shape in plan 3.1), POST /auth/login (portal + identifier + password; generic 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS, dummy bcrypt compare for unknown users, 403 ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED after a correct password for inactive staff / Deactivated members, guests cannot sign in, last_login_at = clock.now(), rate limited), POST /auth/logout, GET /auth/me, POST /auth/forgot-password (202).

Replace the empty app.js: load config, build app (helmet with explicit CSP per D25 after grepping src/public for inline <script> blocks, cookie-parser, express.json limit 100kb, /api/v1 router with requireJson on non-GET/HEAD, API 404, express.static('src/public'), GET / -> 302 /landingpage/index.html, error middleware), listen on PORT unless required as a module. Log startup without secrets.

Edit database/db.sql additively per plan D11: class_waitlist table, class_attendance.booked_via column + CHECK, grading_candidate.result CHECK adds 'Retake', guest_pass pass_type CHECK widened + amount_paid column; class_feedback_prompt table; add the new tables to the DROP list; keep the file re-runnable and update the header comment table-group list. Add a short 'Schema changes for the backend' section to database/README.md. Do not change seed.sql unless the load fails.

Front end shared modules: add src/public/js/api.js (ASK.api/get/post/put/patch/del, ApiError, ASK.boot loading /reference and /auth/me, setting TODAY/skew, in-place fill of DOJOS/PKG/CLASSES/OTHER_DOJO_CLASSES/INSTRUCTORS/BELTS/GRADING_FEE/policies, ASK.d/ts/iso/fill/errToast, ASK.toLogin, ASK.ready promise, script injection from data-then with async=false). Edit core.js: `let TODAY`, add NOW(). Rewrite store.js per plan section 4 (no storage; AUTH/ADMIN from ASK.me; signOut posts /auth/logout; DB = emptyDB() with every top-level key of SEED; keep SEED() available only as an in-memory fallback so unconverted pages still render: for pages not yet converted the loader must seed DB from SEED() at boot; remove save() calls from shared files). Edit portal.js: ALLOWED/ADM_BLOCKED/GATED/P.me from ASK.me, notification-seen flag in memory, drop save() in the page-link handler and the demoOn clause of examinerShift (keep the 15-minute window logic reading from loaded data later).

Convert EVERY html page under src/public/{landingpage,student_portal,instructor_portal,admin_portal}/*.html: replace the <script src> block with core.js, api.js (data-then lists the remaining scripts in the same order, page-relative paths) so behaviour is unchanged. List the converted files in findings. Student/staff sign-in pages (login.js, staff-login.js, signin.html if needed) call POST /auth/login, redirect on success, show server messages through toast; remove sessionStorage ask-last-id, findStaff/showHint lookups (static hint), signIn/signInAdmin; neutralise the Google button with a toast; wire forgot password to the endpoint.

Create verification harness in c:/Users/CedrikHwang/FSDP-C19/.be-tmp/verify/: ensure %TEMP%\askdb has @electric-sql/pglite-socket and pg (npm install there), then write db.mjs, reset-db.mjs, server.mjs, lib.mjs, api-auth.mjs, api-sqli.mjs (login + later search strings), browser-lib.mjs and browser-login.mjs per plan section 7.

Run the harness: reset DB, start the server, run api-auth.mjs (success for all four demo accounts with password123, wrong password 401 generic, inactive ADM-102 403, guest G-01 401, 401 without cookie on /auth/me, JSON-only 415, SQL injection strings in identifier return 401 not 500, cookie flags httpOnly + SameSite=Lax, no password_hash in any response, /meta today = 2026-11-06 with APP_FAKE_TODAY, and fake date ignored when NODE_ENV=production) and browser-login.mjs (sign in through the real forms for the 4 accounts, guards redirect wrong-role access, logout works, zero console errors, storage has no ask-* auth keys).
acceptance_criteria: `node app.js` starts against the PGlite DB loaded with database/db.sql + seed.sql and serves / (302 to /landingpage/index.html) and /api/v1/meta.

POST /api/v1/auth/login succeeds for S-001 (member no ASK-2025-1834 or lervyn@email.com), INS-0042, ADM-001 and ADM-101 with password123 and fails generically for wrong passwords, inactive staff, guests.
GET /api/v1/auth/me returns 401 without the cookie and never contains password_hash.
db.sql then seed.sql still load without errors twice in a row (re-runnable) with the new D11 changes.
Every HTML page loads through api.js; no page references localStorage ask-prototype or sessionStorage ask-role/ask-admin any more; the two sign-in pages work end to end in headless Edge.
verification: node .be-tmp/verify/api-auth.mjs and node .be-tmp/verify/api-sqli.mjs: all checks pass
node .be-tmp/verify/browser-login.mjs: sign-in flows pass, zero console errors, no auth keys in storage
findings:
VERIFIED (all run): api-auth.mjs 68/68, api-sqli.mjs 92/92, browser-login.mjs 162/162 (4 sign-ins through the real forms, guards, logout, storage + httpOnly cookie checks, every page of every portal at 1280 and 390 with zero console errors), npm ci + npm test -- --runInBand exit 0, db.sql + seed.sql load twice with v_grading_conflict = 0. git: nothing staged, branch is backend-integration (not database-integration), HEAD 769e384 unchanged, .env/.gitignore/prompts untouched. package.json and package-lock.json are NOT git-ignored (git check-ignore exit 1): report to the user.

BACKEND FILES: app.js (exports createApp(); listens only when run directly); src/config/{index,db}.js; src/utils/{clock,errors,password,csv}.js; src/middleware/{auth,roles,validate,requireJson,error,rateLimit,security}.js; src/validators/auth.js; src/models/{userModel,referenceModel}.js; src/services/{accountService,authService,referenceService}.js; src/controllers/{authController,metaController}.js; src/routes/{index,meta.routes,auth.routes}.js. Deps (npm install): express 5, pg, bcryptjs 3, jsonwebtoken, cookie-parser, dotenv 18 (quiet:true), helmet 8, express-rate-limit 8, zod 4 (NOT zod 3: use z.strictObject({...}), issue.path/message). Express 5: async handler rejections already reach the error middleware; req.query is a getter; route paths with bare * need a name.

HELPERS LATER FEATS MUST USE: errors.js exports AppError(status,code,message,details), badRequest/unauthorized/forbidden/notFound/conflict(message,code), asyncHandler. db.js exports { pool, query(text, params, db=pool), withTx(fn(tx)) } - models take an optional trailing `db` (tx client) argument and pass it to query(). clock.js: now() (Date), today() ('YYYY-MM-DD' in APP_TZ), ymd(date), hhmm(date), addDays(day,n), addMonths(day,n), diffDays(a,b), diffHours(a,b), at(day,'HH:MM[:SS]') -> instant. pg parsers: DATE -> 'YYYY-MM-DD' string, NUMERIC/INT8 -> number; TIME stays 'HH:MM:SS' (use to_char(...,'HH24:MI') as referenceModel does). validate({body,query,params}) puts parsed values in req.valid.{body,query,params}. Add `.refine(noNul)` style NUL-char rejection on any free-text zod string (PostgreSQL 22021 would otherwise be a 500; see validators/auth.js). requireRole(...roles) and requireAdminType('business') (403 BUSINESS_ADMIN_ONLY; pass ('business') only; front desk = 'frontdesk') in middleware/roles.js. authenticate (middleware/auth.js) sets req.user = session {id, role, adminType, name, memberNo, rank, rankId, dojoId, group:'adult'|'child', gender, age, label, status}; instructors also get chief, photo. accountService exports toSession, deactivatedReason, ordinal, ageOn. middleware/rateLimit.js exports loginLimiter and publicWriteLimiter (use publicWriteLimiter on /public/trial-bookings and /public/registrations). routes/index.js: mount new routers there BEFORE router.use(apiNotFound); requireJson is already applied to the whole /api/v1 router, and express.json({limit:'100kb'}) is mounted in app.js. Auth cookie is ask_token (httpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure only in production). Auth errors: INVALID_CREDENTIALS 401, ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED 403 at login and 401 on a live session, UNAUTHENTICATED/SESSION_EXPIRED 401, WRONG_ROLE 403, JSON_REQUIRED 415, BAD_JSON 400, RATE_LIMITED 429, VALIDATION_ERROR 400 (+details). Login rate limit is env-tunable LOGIN_RATE_MAX / LOGIN_RATE_WINDOW_MS (harness sets 1000; api-auth.mjs spawns a separate app with 3 to prove the 429). Other env read by config: PORT, NODE_ENV, DB_HOST/PORT/NAME/USER/PASSWORD, DB_POOL_MAX, DB_SSL, JWT_SECRET, JWT_EXPIRES_IN, APP_TZ, APP_FAKE_TODAY, TRUST_PROXY (document all in README at FEAT-006). .env.example got JWT_SECRET and JWT_EXPIRES_IN placeholders only.

API SHAPES: GET /api/v1/meta -> {today, now, tz, fakeToday}. GET /api/v1/reference -> meta fields + dojos[{id,name,short,code,region,addr,status}] (no qr_token), belts[{id,g,c,order,fee}], packages{adult[],kids[]} (PKG shape; lessons null = unlimited; fields t,name,amt,unit?,d,per,lessons,days?,months?,valid,best?,compassion?), policies{registration,annualDues,discounts{senior{age,pct},student{from,to,pct}},booking{aheadMonths,minDays,cancelHours,maxPackages},compassionDays,lateFee}, instructors[{id,name,dan,photo,chief}], timetable{hq[],other[]} rows {id,code,dojo,day,time,end,mat,type,ins,cap,kids,online} (private lessons excluded). Package labels t/per/valid/best are derived in services/referenceService.js (best = a25 and k6, marketing flag not in the DB). POST /auth/login {portal,identifier,password} -> {user: session}. GET /auth/me -> session. POST /auth/logout, POST /auth/forgot-password (202).

SCHEMA (db.sql, additive, re-runnable, seed.sql untouched and loads fine): class_waitlist; class_attendance.booked_via; grading_candidate.result allows 'Retake'; guest_pass.pass_type widened to trial/single/day/week/month/private + guest_pass.amount_paid; class_feedback_prompt; indexes idx_waitlist_user and idx_feedback_prompt_user; DROP list and header table list updated; database/README.md has a 'Schema changes for the backend' section.

CSP (middleware/security.js): helmet with explicit directives, useDefaults false. script-src 'self' plus sha256 hashes computed at startup from every bare <script>...</script> in src/public/**/*.html (the trailing-slash redirect on 4 index.html pages), script-src-attr 'unsafe-inline' because landing pages use onerror="this.remove()" in about.html and public.js templates (tighten in FEAT-006 by removing those handlers), style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' fonts.googleapis.com, font-src fonts.gstatic.com data:, img-src 'self' data: blob: aikidoshinjukai.com.sg, frame-src youtube, youtube-nocookie, maps.google.com, www.google.com (dojo map embeds), connect-src 'self', object-src none, frame-ancestors 'self', upgrade-insecure-requests + HSTS only in production. If a later FEAT adds a new external host or inline script, update this file.

FRONT END: HTML conversion done for ALL 39 pages (landingpage 9: about, class, classes, dojo, dojos, fees, index, join, trial; student_portal 8: book, checkin, grading, index, login, packages, payments, profile; instructor_portal 3: grading, index, profile; admin_portal 19: applications, equipment, followups, grading, imports, index, insights, member, members, notify, payments, policies, register, reports, revenue, roster, sessions, signin, staff). Every page now has `<script src="../js/core.js"></script><script src="../js/api.js" data-then="<page-relative list in the old order, data.js removed>"></script>`. api.js ALWAYS loads data.js itself first (sibling of api.js), then calls ASK.applyReference, then injects the data-then scripts with async=false, then calls coreReady() (core.js: the old DOMContentLoaded enhance/autoLabelTables/animateIn block became function coreReady(); page scripts load after DOMContentLoaded now, so never rely on that event in a page script). New data modules for a page (student-data.js etc.) go into that page's data-then list after store.js (and after portal.js only if they need P/ALLOWED; page scripts run runPage(...) at load, so load the data module BEFORE the page script and have the page script await ASK.load.* inside its runPage handlers).

api.js (src/public/js/api.js) exposes const ASK = {API, skewMs, me, ref, load{}, act{}, fallbackSeed:true}; class ApiError{status,code,message,details}; ASK.api(method,path,body,{noRedirect}) + get/post/put/patch/del (body defaults to {} for non-GET, always JSON; 401 -> ASK.toLogin() unless noRedirect; toLogin only acts on pages with data-portal); ASK.csv(path,name); ASK.d('YYYY-MM-DD')->local-midnight Date, ASK.ts(iso)->Date, ASK.iso(date), ASK.fill(arr, items) (in place), ASK.errToast(e), ASK.applyReference (fills DOJOS, PKG, CLASSES, OTHER_DOJO_CLASSES, INSTRUCTORS, BELTS, GRADING_FEE in place; CLASSES/OTHER keep their prototype `booked` figure and gain id/code/end/mat/online), ASK.applyPolicies(DB.policies) (called by store.js), ASK.applyMe (copies the student account into the ME const), ASK.ready (promise). core.js: `let TODAY` (set to the server date) and NOW() (server clock). 

store.js is rewritten: no storage; AUTH.role/ADMIN from ASK.me; signOut() posts /auth/logout then redirects; DB = emptyDB() (every SEED key, empty) and, while ASK.fallbackSeed is true, Object.assign(DB, SEED()) + fallbackExtras(DB) (the old admSeed block, in memory) so UNCONVERTED pages still render. TRANSITION ITEMS that later FEATs must delete when they convert the last user: `function save() {}` no-op stub (page scripts still call it: student.js ~25 calls, instructor.js, admin-*.js, admin.js, join.js, trial.js), recordMyAttendance() (student.js ~L978 and instructor.js still call it; the server does this now), SEED()/fallbackExtras/ASK.fallbackSeed (FEAT-006 removes), DB.panels demoOn flags inside SEED (instructor.js still has the demo toggle at ~L567 and reads DB.panels[0].demoOn: FEAT-003 removes it; portal.js examinerShift no longer honours demoOn). Removed from store.js: DB_KEY, reviveDates, rmSeed/fbSeed/admSeed migrations, resetDemo, [data-reset] handler, signIn, signInAdmin, pagehide save. A student who is not Lervyn still sees Lervyn's SEED data on unconverted student pages (ME is overwritten with the real account, data is not) until FEAT-002 converts them.

portal.js: P.me for student/instructor now comes from ASK.me (initials, name, label); examinerShift uses NOW() and ignores demoOn; notification seen flag is the in-memory `notifSeen`; [data-page-link] no longer saves. localStorage is still used for UI prefs ask-rail, ask-home-view, ask-sound (allowed, D13). data.js: SEED 'Test session' panel date now new Date(TODAY) (server date) instead of the browser clock. join.js: removed the sessionStorage ask-last-id write (the join page is still SEED/APPS based until FEAT-002). Sign-in pages: student_portal/login.js (member no ASK-/EXT- or email accepted client side, server decides; Google button only toasts 'not available yet'; forgot password calls /auth/forgot-password) and admin_portal/staff-login.js (no account lookup: static hint; error toast shows server message; 401 -> generic mismatch text, 403 -> deactivated message). staff-login.js still defines STAFF_ID.types (unused).

GOTCHAS: (1) the repo files are CRLF; the str_replace tool preserves that, but never rewrite whole HTML files with a tool that converts line endings. (2) pglite-socket under test: server run with DB_POOL_MAX=1; never open a second pool query while inside withTx. (3) The harness scripts spawn their OWN app instances via lib.spawnApp(extraEnv) (api-auth, api-sqli, browser-login), so server.mjs is only needed for manual runs; db.mjs must be running (node .be-tmp/verify/db.mjs in the background, writes .be-tmp/verify/.dbport; killing it leaves a stale .dbport that is safe to delete) and each suite calls resetDb() itself. (4) harness helpers for later suites: lib.mjs exports spawnApp, resetDb, pgConnect, client(base) (cookie jar with get/post/put/patch/del and rawCookies), login(base,portal,id), ACCOUNTS, suite(name) -> {check, expect(label, res, status, code), done}, ROOT, HERE; browser-lib.mjs exports launch, newPage(browser, base, {width, problems, allow}), settle, signInStudent, signInStaff(page, base, 'instructor'|'admin', id), storageDump, htmlPagesOf(dir), SCREENS. api-sqli.mjs exports SQLI (reuse for search endpoints). Run all three suites: node .be-tmp/verify/api-auth.mjs; node .be-tmp/verify/api-sqli.mjs; node .be-tmp/verify/browser-login.mjs. (5) Login rate limit would 429 later suites if LOGIN_RATE_MAX is not raised: lib.appEnv sets it to 1000. (6) Time-of-day: APP_FAKE_TODAY pins only the date; the instructor SEED 'Test session' (20:00-21:00 today, access from 19:45) therefore opens depending on the real clock, so browser suites must accept either outcome for instructor_portal/grading.html (browser-login accepts the redirect to index.html but would also pass when the page opens) unless they insert their own grading_session fixture. (7) Seed anchors: today 2026-11-06 via APP_FAKE_TODAY; S-001 Lervyn = ASK-2025-1834 / lervyn@email.com, INS-0042 Bob Tan Sensei, ADM-001 Grace Lim (business), ADM-101 Daniel Ong (frontdesk), ADM-102 Farah Yusof inactive, G-01 aisyah@email.com guest, password123 for all. HQ timetable has 19 weekly templates, 20 other-dojo rows, 530 class_session rows, 54 users.
